chapters.title: A bright spring
chapters.summary: Sofia opened a stall of her own. Mia started helping at Sofia's stall. The school planted a garden. Rosa, a net mender from a town with no sea, came because of the net store you built. Emma and Mia became firm friends. You began a harbour lamp by the harbour.

chapters.title: The spring of the great storm
chapters.summary: When the great storm came, the harbour saved its boats. The pub started a quiz night. The Anchor made its music night a monthly thing. Hana, a cheesemaker from the city, came because of the cheese shop you built. Leo and Mia became firm friends. You began a study hut by Island School.

chapters.title: The inspector's visit
chapters.summary: Ivo's fishing family came to live in the harbour. A lamp was lit on the point. The inspector found the school at its best. Emma and Rosa became firm friends. Rowan was born to Jonas and Rosa. You built a bench by the harbour.

chapters.title: The storm we boarded up against
chapters.summary: When the great storm came, the harbour boarded up and held. Leo and Evan became firm friends. Jonas and Mara fell out. You built a bench by the harbour.

chapters.title: The lean season we shared
chapters.summary: Ada the traveller made the harbour her home. When times were hard, the harbour shared what it had. Maeve and Arun got together at the opening of the bandstand on the square. Jonas and Hana became firm friends. You built a bench by the harbour.

chapters.title: The autumn Mara and Emma became firm friends
chapters.summary: The inspector found the school at its best. The whole harbour came to Emma and Ada's party at Anchor Pub. Mara and Rosa became firm friends. You began a weaving shed by Island School.

chapters.title: The autumn Leo and Ada became firm friends
chapters.summary: When the great storm came, the harbour boarded up and held. Leo and Ada became firm friends. Noah and Ivo became firm friends.

chapters.title: The winter Jonas and Sofia fell out
chapters.summary: When times were hard, the harbour shared what it had. Harbour Bakery closed its doors. A baby for Maeve and Arun: little Willa. Mara and Ada became firm friends.

chapters.title: The winter Jonas and Mia drifted apart
chapters.summary: Harbour Bakery closed its doors. Mara reopened the bakery. The inspector found the school at its best. Jonas and Mia drifted apart. Noah and Maeve became firm friends.

chapters.title: The winter Sofia and Ada became firm friends
chapters.summary: When the great storm came, the harbour boarded up and held. Sofia and Ada became firm friends. Sofia and Rosa became firm friends.

Finished at last: the harbour clock going again.
Noah was the first to try out the harbour clock going again.
Jonas spent all day getting the harbour ready for the mackerel run.
The mackerel came in off the point, as good as last year, around the net store you made.
Jonas was the last to leave the harbour after the mackerel run.
